body:
The declaration index currently duplicates nominal payload ownership: case_fields clones a field vector (identity_payer.rs391–393), then resolve_program.rs277–320 clones variant cases/fields into ResolvedProgram.types and325–335 clones parameters.

Keep one canonical per-module nominal payload and lend its checked views to index/resolution consumers, transferring or sharing genuine ownership through finalization. Prefer an internal ownership change that preserves public projections/API. Preserve bounded iterative destruction; naive recursive Rc/Arc Drop is not acceptable. This is distinct from already implemented #777 HIR leases and #785 immutable identity backing.

Owning roots: src/hir/declaration_index/identity_payer.rs and src/hir/resolve_program.rs, with nominal HIR-node/linker consumers. One lane owns root integration; the separate base-prelude producer lane must not edit these shared roots until coordinated.

Discovery: source-only Astra audit at 4ec48420b6e78b1035a66cc406893c46c3028464. This is a real allocation-owner finding, not established application failure causality or measured token/RSS savings. Keep current corrected prelude accounting until a producer-backed replacement is executable. No language caps, work allowances, forecast discounts, global caches, authority shortcuts, or weakened acceptance tests.

Acceptance: complete independently retained original/current HIR, diagnostic, graph/digest, cold/warm cache and backend parity; exact public IDs and order; physical actual allocation/highwater/complete iterative Drop observations; exact/one-short/zero/sticky refusal before acquisition; same cumulative replay work. Original application owners must run unchanged in a later combined batch, with failures disclosed. Publish to wavect/v0-10-0 / PR #761; no per-ticket Cargo jobs.
title: (OPT) Keep one canonical nominal payload through declaration indexing and HIR resolution
